### E2E

#### `E2E-UPLOAD-01` — 1.5 GB upload is hashed, stored immutably and memory-bounded `*`

**Verdict:** PASS

**Bullets:**
- ✓ the response is 201 Created | observed: see Evidence
- ✓ the response `sha256` equals the file's `sha256sum` | observed: see Evidence
- ✓ peak sampled RSS minus idle RSS is below 100 MB | observed: see Evidence
- ✓ `/data/blobs/sha256/<first 2 hex>/<sha256>.zip` exists in the `api` container with mode `0444` | observed: see Evidence
- ✓ that stored file's size equals the source file's size | observed: see Evidence

**Evidence**

<details>
<summary>Show raw evidence</summary>

```
201; sha256 983c8fa0…4a17 == sha256sum; idle RSS 247104 KB, peak 272920 KB, growth 25,816 KB (~25 MB, 12 samples @500ms) < 100 MB; blob mode 444, size 1610614623 == source
interpretation note: `curl --data-binary @file` aborts on this host (curl 7.81.0: 'option --data-binary: out of memory' for a 1.5 GB file). Interpreted as `curl -X POST -T <file>` (streamed raw-bytes body, same headers); the project's own scripts/e2e/upload_memory.sh uses the same form. RSS measured on the uvicorn process (PID 1) in the api container via `ps`.
```

</details>

<summary>Show raw evidence</summary>

```
killed curl at ~827 MB sent; /data/blobs/tmp empty immediately and at +5 s (no .part); GET collections items []
interpretation note: Same `-T` interpretation as E2E-UPLOAD-01; curl rate-limited to 150 MB/s so it could be killed at ~half; killed with SIGKILL once the server's .part file reached >= 768 MiB.
```

## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `curl --data-binary` on the 1.5 GB fixture — curl 7.81.0 on this host aborts with `option --data-binary: out of memory`; E2E-UPLOAD-01/02 were exercised with `curl -X POST -T` (streamed raw body, identical headers). Flagged `*` on E2E-UPLOAD-01.
- Browser sandbox — the cached Chromium needed `libasound.so.2`, absent on the host; supplied from an extracted Ubuntu deb through `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` (outside the project).
- Browser console showed `404` for `/favicon.ico` on UI pages; not asserted by any contract item.
- Prior run `eval-report-2026-10-02T13-30-00Z` recorded gate `check` failing on `src/app/matters/page.test.tsx > renders_empty_state_when_no_matters`; the progress file called it flaky. In this run `make check` passed, including web-test (76/76).
- Teardown with `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f <override> down` also stopped/removed the shared `db`, `api`, `worker`, `web` containers of the `chatledger` compose project; the original stack was brought back with `docker compose up -d --wait` (now running the rebuilt, HEAD-matching images against the default `chatledger` DB and `chatledger_blobstore` volume, both untouched).
- Pre-existing untracked `.orchestrate.lock` (PID 226550, dead), `orchestration-*.md` and the earlier eval report were left untouched.
